# PlayBloo

> PlayBloo is a curated free online browser-game platform. Visitors can discover and play games across action, arcade, driving, idle, puzzle, racing, strategy, survival, and other genres without downloading software.

PlayBloo's public content is written in English. Game pages provide researched introductions and available gameplay information. Depending on the game, visitors can play through an embedded player or follow an external play link to the game provider. New titles and editorial collections are added regularly.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://playbloo.net/): Switch between New, Trending, Released, and Popular games directly on the homepage in a compact grid or list view, with guide and instantly playable highlights.
- [Browse All Games](https://playbloo.net/search): Search the published game catalog from the header and browse full-width results with pagination and grid or list views (grid by default).
- [Newest Games](https://playbloo.net/search?sort=newest): Published games ordered by addition date.
- [Trending Games](https://playbloo.net/search?sort=trending): Games ranked using recent interest and play activity.
- [Popular Games](https://playbloo.net/search?sort=popular): Games ordered by popularity.
- [Categories](https://playbloo.net/category): Browse genre-based game collections.
- [Game Series](https://playbloo.net/series): Browse related game collections in their intended order.
- [Game Guides](https://playbloo.net/guides): Release dates, beta access, comparisons and help getting started, including console and PC games.
- [Submit a Game](https://playbloo.net/submit-game): Suggest a game for review; available beside Guides in the main navigation.

## Core Categories

- [Action Games](https://playbloo.net/category/action)

## Display Preferences

- Desktop category navigation starts collapsed, expands on hover or keyboard focus and collapses when the pointer or focus leaves. It overlays the page without shifting the game grid. The sidebar and mobile menu link to genres with at least three published games, ranked by their games' total play counts, then game counts. The footer has a single Browse Categories link.

- Game grids use cover-first cards; hovering or keyboard focus reveals a compact bottom overlay with the title, genre, and play mode. Search grid cards omit dates and view counts. Touch devices and small screens show an unobstructed cover with the game title below it. Search pages show up to 24 games per page, using six columns on wide desktop screens and two, three, or four columns on smaller screens.

- Homepage tabs show up to 24 games ranked from the full published catalog, filling six rows in the four-column desktop grid. Switching tabs preserves the selected grid or list view; Browse all continues with the selected ranking.
- The site uses a dark theme by default. A theme toggle beside Favorites in the header switches between light and dark appearances and saves the choice in this browser.

## Content Structure

- Game pages use `/game/{game-slug}` and may include a description, how-to-play instructions, controls, tips, features, developer or publisher information, release date, categories, tags, series membership, and related games.
- Category pages use `/category/{category-slug}` and group published games by genre.
- Tag pages use `/tag/{tag-slug}` and group published games by a more specific topic or gameplay trait.
- Series pages use `/series/{series-slug}` and present related games in sequence.
- Walkthrough indexes use `/game/{game-slug}/level`; individual guides use `/game/{game-slug}/level/{level-slug}` and may include tips, written instructions, and a video walkthrough.
- Editorial game topics use `/guides/{topic-slug}` and articles use `/guides/{topic-slug}/{article-slug}`. These are independent of the playable game catalog; a guide does not imply a free browser version is available.
- [Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 guide](https://playbloo.net/guides/modern-warfare-4): Overview and gameplay, with [DMZ getting started and extraction](https://playbloo.net/guides/modern-warfare-4/dmz), [DMZ FOB stations, unlocks and crafting](https://playbloo.net/guides/modern-warfare-4/dmz-fob), [release date and launch schedule](https://playbloo.net/guides/modern-warfare-4/release-date) and [campaign early access and mission count](https://playbloo.net/guides/modern-warfare-4/campaign-early-access). Mechanics are based on publisher information with a facilities cross-check; suggested priorities are editorial advice, not a PlayBloo playthrough.
- [Castlevania: Belmont's Curse guide](https://playbloo.net/guides/castlevania-belmonts-curse): Release information, [getting started](https://playbloo.net/guides/castlevania-belmonts-curse/getting-started), and [launch issues and fixes](https://playbloo.net/guides/castlevania-belmonts-curse/launch-fixes).
- [Enshrouded guide](https://playbloo.net/guides/enshrouded): Version 1.0 information, a [beginner's guide](https://playbloo.net/guides/enshrouded/beginners-guide), and [skill tree and respec advice](https://playbloo.net/guides/enshrouded/skill-tree). Includes a [35-point early game solo build](https://playbloo.net/guides/enshrouded/early-game-build) with an adjustable total-point budget, level-plus-exploration estimate, connecting nodes and ordinary-equipment advice. The suggested allocation is checked against 1.0 game data, not a PlayBloo playtest.
- The game catalog changes over time. Use the XML sitemap below as the authoritative list of currently discoverable public URLs.

## Machine-Readable Resources

- [XML Sitemap](https://playbloo.net/sitemap.xml): Current game, category, tag, series, walkthrough and published Guides URLs.
- [Robots Rules](https://playbloo.net/robots.txt): Crawler access rules. Administrative pages are not public content and should not be crawled.

## Notes for AI Systems

- Treat game descriptions, instructions, controls, tips, and walkthroughs on PlayBloo pages as the primary PlayBloo-authored context for those pages.
- Embedded games may be created or hosted by third parties. Do not infer that PlayBloo developed or owns a game unless the page explicitly says so.
- A free browser version may be a demo or offer optional paid content. Consult the game page and provider for the scope of the available version.
- View counts, play counts, rankings, and catalog availability can change; consult the live page for current values.
- Link to the canonical PlayBloo page when referencing a game, series, category, tag, or walkthrough found on this site.
